'''Asia Capital Reinsurance Group''' ("Asia Capital Re") is a Singapore-based reinsurance company.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.asiacapitalre.com/en/About-Us/|title=About Us|access-date=14 November 2013|publisher=Asia Capital Re}}</ref> It was founded in 2006 by Tan Kwang Kherng,<ref name="A:A"/> [[Khazanah Nasional Berhad]], and [[3i]].<ref name="A:B"/> In May 2008, Asia Capital Re launched '''ACR ReTakaful Holdings Limited''', a [[joint venture]] between [[Khazanah Nasional Berhad]] and the [[Dubai Islamic Investment Group]].<ref name="B:C"/> In 2019, Asia Capital Re stopped writing new business,<ref name="A:C"/> and in 2020, ACR was acquired by Catalina Holdings (Bermuda) Ltd.<ref name="A:D"/> Wei-Lyn Loh became CEO of Asia Capital Re in 2022.<ref name="B:D"/>

==History==
===2006-2014===
Asia Capital Re was founded in November 2006 by Tan Kwang Kherng, who served as the company's first Group [[Chief executive officer|Chief Executive Officer]] (CEO).<ref name="A:A">{{cite web |url=https://etiqa.com/our-leaders-post/john-tan-kwang-kherng/|title=John Tan Kwang Kherng Biography|access-date=23 November 2024|publisher=Etiqa Insurance}}</ref> The company was co-founded with strategic financial support from [[Khazanah Nasional Berhad]], Malaysia's [[sovereign wealth fund]], and [[3i]], a [[private equity firm]] from the United Kingdom.<ref name="A:B">{{cite web |url=https://www.3i.com/media-centre/corporate-and-portfolio-news/2006/3i-and-khazanah-successfully-complete-lead-investment-in-acr-s-us-620-million-inaugural-private-placement/|title=3i and Khazanah Complete Investment in ACR|access-date=23 November 2024|publisher=3i Group}}</ref>

Asia Capital Re gained recognition early in its operations as a leading regional reinsurance provider.<ref>The Report: Indonesia, 2013 : Economy, Banking, Energy, Oxford Business Group - 2013 Page 117 "A reinsurance centre for the region, Singapore captures much of this ceded risk both through local players, like Asia Capital Re (ACR), and through branches of leading global reinsurers including a growing number of Lloyd's syndicates."</ref> The company became known for providing reinsurance solutions across various lines, including property, motor, marine, agriculture, engineering, and aviation, serving clients across the pan-Asian region.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.businessnewsasia.com/2019120552314302-catalina-holdings-acquire-asia-capital-reinsurance-group/|title=Catalina Holdings to Acquire Asia Capital Reinsurance Group|access-date=23 November 2024|publisher=Business News Asia}}</ref> In its first year of operation, it received an initial financial strength rating of A− (Excellent) from [[AM Best]], the world's leading [[credit rating agency]]. This rating, one of the highest among Asian reinsurers, was reaffirmed in December 2007.<ref name="B:A">{{cite web |url=https://media.lockelord.com/files/upload/press_release_001_001.pdf|title=ACR Press Release|access-date=23 November 2024|publisher=Locke Lord}}</ref>

Beyond Singapore, ACR expanded its footprint with a joint venture reinsurance company in Malaysia, as well as representative offices in Taipei and Bahrain.<ref name="B:A"/>

===2015-2025===
Tan Kwang Kherng, the company's founder, served as Group CEO until 2015, when he retired due to medical advice. He remained involved in a non-executive role as founder and senior advisor.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://sg-reinsurers.org.sg/industry-veteran-john-tan-announces-retirement-his-executive-positions-asia-capital-re-medical|title=Industry veteran John Tan announces retirement|access-date=23 November 2024|publisher=Singapore Reinsurers' Association}}</ref> In 2015, Hans-Peter Gerhardt succeeded Tan as Group Chief Executive Officer. Gerhardt, who brought extensive global insurance experience to the company, announced his intention to step down in 2017.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.insurancebusinessmag.com/asia/news/breaking-news/asia-capital-re-names-bobby-heerasing-as-deputy-ceo-70274.aspx|title=Asia Capital Re Names Bobby Heerasing as Deputy CEO|access-date=23 November 2024|publisher=Insurance Business Asia}}</ref> Following Gerhardt's departure, Bobby Heerasing joined the company as Deputy CEO in 2017 and subsequently assumed leadership as Acting CEO. Heerasing was later confirmed as CEO and Executive Director, a role he held until 2020. During his tenure, he played a significant role in steering the company through its acquisition by Catalina Holdings.<ref name="A:C"/>

==== Cessation of new business ====
As of December 5, 2019, Asia Capital Re stopped writing new business, while continuing to service existing policies until their expiration date.<ref name="A:C">{{cite web |url=https://www.spglobal.com/marketintelligence/en/news-insights/latest-news-headlines/catalina-holdings-closes-acquisition-of-singapore-s-asia-capital-re-57842161|title=Catalina Holdings Closes Acquisition of Asia Capital Re|access-date=23 November 2024|publisher=S&P Global}}</ref>

==== Acquisition by Catalina Holdings ====
In March 2020, ACR was acquired by '''Catalina Holdings (Bermuda) Ltd.''', a specialist in managing legacy (re)insurance portfolios. This acquisition marked Catalina's entry into the Asian market and expanded its total assets to approximately US$7.2 billion.<ref name="A:D">{{cite web |url=https://www.insurancebusinessmag.com/asia/news/breaking-news/catalina-holdings-completes-acquisition-of-asia-capital-re-218623.aspx|title=Catalina Holdings Completes Acquisition of Asia Capital Re|access-date=23 November 2024|publisher=Insurance Business Asia}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.spglobal.com/marketintelligence/en/news-insights/latest-news-headlines/catalina-holdings-closes-acquisition-of-singapore-s-asia-capital-re-57842161|title=Catalina Holdings Closes Acquisition of ACR|access-date=23 November 2024|publisher=S&P Global}}</ref>

In 2020, after Catalina Holdings acquired Asia Capital Re, Martin Kauer was appointed as CEO and CFO. Kauer, who previously served as CEO and CFO of Glacier Reinsurance AG, focused on integrating Asia Capital Re into Catalina Holdings’ global operations during his tenure.<ref name="A:C"/> On June 13, 2022, Wei-Lyn Loh was appointed CEO of Asia Capital Re.<ref name="B:D">{{cite web |url=https://www.reinsurancene.ws/asia-capital-re-appoints-wei-lyn-loh-as-new-ceo/|title=Asia Capital Re Appoints Wei-Lyn Loh as New CEO|access-date=23 November 2024|publisher=Reinsurance News}}</ref>

==Joint ventures==
=== ACR ReTakaful Holdings ===
In May 2008, Asia Capital Re launched '''ACR ReTakaful Holdings Limited''', a joint venture between [[Khazanah Nasional Berhad]], the investment arm of the Malaysian government, and the [[Dubai Islamic Investment Group]], a global Sharia-compliant investment company.<ref name="B:C"/> ACR ReTakaful Holdings Limited aimed to establish operations in both Malaysia and the Middle East, with the intention of leveraging its partners’ strengths in financial stability, networks, and access to local markets. By doing so, it contributed to the development of the retakaful sector, which historically saw much of its business ceded to international markets outside of Asia.<ref name="B:C">The Report: Bahrain 2009 - Page 75 Oxford Business Group - "The takaful segment also recently saw a new player when Asia Capital Reinsurance for ReTakaful was granted a licence. The company is a subsidiary of ACR ReTakaful Holdings, itself a joint venture between Dubai Islamic Investment Group ..."</ref><ref>Gulf Business - Volume 13, 2008 Page 14 - "ACR Retakaful Holdings Limited is a joint venture between Dubai Group, Khazanah Nasional Bhd, the investment arm of the Malaysian Government and Singapore-based Asia Capital Reinsurance (ACR). The deal was completed through..."</ref> The new entity was established with an initial capital of US$300 million, positioning it as the world's largest retakaful (Islamic reinsurance) company at the time. The company is headquartered at the [[Dubai International Financial Centre]] and focuses on providing Sharia-compliant reinsurance solutions.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://sg-reinsurers.org.sg/industry-veteran-john-tan-announces-retirement-his-executive-positions-asia-capital-re-medical|title=Asia Capital Re in $300m retakaful launch|access-date=23 November 2024|publisher=Singapore Reinsurers' Association}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://media.lockelord.com/files/upload/press_release_001_001.pdf|title=ACR ReTakaful Press Release|access-date=23 November 2024|publisher=Locke Lord}}</ref>
